shots.label: 종이를 찢고 등장
shots.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE landscape 16:9 full-bleed interactive exhibition concept artwork. Use the attached image as the primary reference for ART DIRECTION: acid lemon yellow aged paper, faded teal, vermilion red, berry magenta, huge ink-black shapes, circular colored spots, concentric target-like graphics, blunt rounded silhouettes, rough misregistered screenprinting, distressed ink and yellowed paper grain. Closely capture its flat strange cheerful-but-uncanny collage aesthetic. Do not reproduce its existing characters or lettering. Transform this visual language into an ORIGINAL miniature PAPER CITY inhabited by tiny ivory bean-shaped residents with two dot eyes, stubby limbs and small blue ribbon bows. Buildings are cut from printed packaging-like rectangular paper, with bold dotted roofs, abstract circular ornaments, black doorways, crooked red bridges, impossible intersecting paper stairs. Clearly urban, with streets, apartments and tiny doors; not merely decorative wallpaper. Dominant lemon-yellow and black with red architecture; teal/magenta accents. Avoid ornate European castles, lace, roses, realistic 3D rendering and generic pastel fantasy.
The exhibition concept is a visitor filmed with a webcam and chroma key TEARING THROUGH the inhabitants' paper world, becoming a playful gigantic invader who picks up, eats and throws residents and crushes PAPER buildings. A single adult East Asian woman with dark shoulder-length hair and plain black top appears as an unmistakably PHOTOGRAPHIC live-video cutout, face and hands natural skin tones and accurate anatomy, contrasted against the flat printed paper city. Show the final screen composite, no hardware or exhibition room. Make ragged yellow paper tears with exposed white fibrous edges and curled printed paper flaps unmistakable around where she emerges; this is NOT an intact rectangular window. Black empty space behind the torn paper. Residents are very small, fingertip size or smaller, and cute even when startled. No gore or realistic injury. Same world throughout. Strong graphic hierarchy, lively empty space and distinct composition. No captions, words, watermark, letters or UI. SHOT: the dramatic first intrusion. A quiet city occupies the lower half, rows of little red and teal flat-paper apartments, lemon-yellow printed roofs, crooked stair bridges. Above center, giant photoreal woman's face and shoulders emerge through a huge jagged hole in the patterned yellow sky. Both hands are visibly grasping the two opposite torn paper edges and pulling them apart; outward-curled paper shows its blank ivory backside and ripped fibers. The tear cuts through a strip of printed upper city architecture so the entire world feels like a sheet being ripped. Little triangular paper scraps falling. The woman looks delighted and curious, looking downward. Tiny ivory blue-bow residents on the bottom street stop, look up and run in various directions with tiny graphic surprise ticks. Colored dot and target patterns on the paper frame, bold red/black/yellow, flat cut-paper stage depth, poster-like impact. The tearing action must be immediately clear. No one is held or eaten in this shot.
